resources.string: Hardware is preferred when enabled. When disabled, ExoPlayer prefers software but may fall back to hardware if needed; mpv disables hardware decoding. The stream information shows the decoder actually used. For catch-up programmes and recordings in ExoPlayer, decoder changes apply on the next opening.

Automatic uses Android audio decoding and FFmpeg when the format is unsupported. Enable to prefer FFmpeg software audio; video decoding remains independent. Does not affect mpv or external players. For catch-up programmes and recordings in ExoPlayer, decoder changes apply on the next opening.
Allows mpv to signal the video colour space to the display. Does not affect ExoPlayer or external players. Turning it off does not guarantee HDR-to-SDR conversion.
